If they are making it open world I wouldn't worry about it. I only see positive aspects so far. The points touched upon in the video seem insignificant and the video already provides explanations for them too.

It's been done in ME1 more or less successfully. Bioware can learn from the issues for combat from there... because there were a lot in ME1. Looking at the combat ME3 was also an improvement upon ME2, which was purely cover based and had only cover when you had to expect enemies and otherwise it didn't have cover. Levels were far too predictable in ME2 due to that. ME3 had a much better way with cover and when they can build on that for ME:A and maybe even add some more openess to the very linear and narrow levels I'm all for it.
